Forerunner Beam Turret.name: FORERUNNER BEAM TURRET
Forerunner Beam Turret.shortDesc: Forerunner Beam Turret deployable for campaign and warzone

Spirit Chin Gun.name: SPIRIT CHIN GUN
Spirit Chin Gun.shortDesc: Spirit Chin Gun deployable for campaign and warzone

Carbine.name: Carbine
Carbine.shortDesc: Carbine with Holoscope. Versatile semi-automatic rifle renowned for its accuracy and long range. New production models use a streamlined manufacturing process and reactive materials in place of radioisotopes for coating projectiles.

Phantom Chin Gun.name: PHANTOM CHIN GUN
Phantom Chin Gun.shortDesc: Phantom Chin Gun deployable for campaign and warzone

Lightrifle.name: LightRifle
Lightrifle.shortDesc: Accurate and powerful, LightRifles were the standard-issue weapon of ancient Promethean warriors.

Storm Rifle.name: Storm Rifle
Storm Rifle.shortDesc: Rapid-fire plasma rifle effective out to medium range when Smart-Link is engaged. Sustained fire can temporarily overheat the weapon.

Binary Rifle.name: Binary Rifle
Binary Rifle.shortDesc: Semi-automatic sniper energy rifle with variable-zoom 4x/9x optics. Use Smart-Link when engaging targets at long range.

Plasma Pistol.name: Plasma Pistol
Plasma Pistol.shortDesc: Semi-automatic energy pistol that fires packets of superheated plasma. Holding down the trigger, then releasing, will fire a tracking overcharge shot with an EMP effect that will disable vehicles and knock out shields.

Scorpion.name: Scorpion
Scorpion.shortDesc: Main battle tank armed with a heavy cannon and pintle-mounted heavy machine gun. This new iteration of the storied Scorpion is half the mass of the old M808 yet has nearly identical firepower and armor protection.

Suppressor.name: Suppressor
Suppressor.shortDesc: Fully-automatic energy rifle effective at short range. Accuracy significantly improves when using Smart-Link.

Boltshot.name: Boltshot
Boltshot.shortDesc: Burst-fire energy pistol. Bolts home-in on close range targets. This new functionality appears to be related to other adaptations the Prometheans have displayed since the disappearance of the Didact.

Mantis.name: Mantis
Mantis.shortDesc: Combat walker armed with heavy machine gun and missile launcher. Missiles can lock-on to aerial targets. Melee unleashes a devastating stomp attack. Extended use of the heavy machine gun will cause it to overheat.

Banshee.name: Banshee
Banshee.shortDesc: Agile ground attack aircraft. Armed with rapid-fire plasma cannons and secondary fuel rod cannon. Can perform acrobatic rolls and loops or high-speed boosts.

Wraith.name: Wraith
Wraith.shortDesc: Assault tank armed with a heavy plasma mortar and pintle-mounted plasma cannon. Can boost for quick sprints. The latest Wraith revisits an ancient Sangheili design that is easier to manufacture and less costly to lose.

Warthog.name: Warthog
Warthog.shortDesc: Warthog armed reconnaissance configuration fitted with a rotary autocannon on a full-rotation turret mount.

Assault Rifle.name: Assault Rifle
Assault Rifle.shortDesc: Assault Rifle with Projection Sight. Standard-issue fully-automatic rifle effective at short to medium range.

Smg.name: SMG
Smg.shortDesc: SMG with CQB Sight. Rapid fire submachine gun best suited for close-quarters combat while leveraging Smart-Link.

Scattershot.name: Scattershot
Scattershot.shortDesc: Short-range semi-automatic energy shotgun. Energy projectiles ricochet off hard surfaces and exhibit homing behavior.

Ghost.name: Ghost
Ghost.shortDesc: Fast attack bike fitted with dual rapid-fire plasma cannons. Can boost for extra speed, at the expense of maneuverability.

Railgun.name: Railgun
Railgun.shortDesc: Powerful single-shot coilgun that requires a short charge cycle before firing. Will automatically fire if the charge is held for too long.

Mongoose.name: Mongoose
Mongoose.shortDesc: Heavy-duty all-terrain quad bike. A passenger can be accommodated on the rear-facing seat.

Hydra Launcher.name: Hydra Launcher
Hydra Launcher.shortDesc: Portable mini-missile launcher. Use Smart-Link to lock-on to targets before firing.

Spartan Laser.name: Spartan Laser
Spartan Laser.shortDesc: Anti-vehicle laser. Requires a short warmup time before firing.

Needler.name: Needler
Needler.shortDesc: Exotic weapon which fires shards that home in on short-range targets. If multiple shards strike a target they will detonate - creating a "supercombine" explosion. Will bounce off heavy armor, such as that used by vehicles and Hunters.

Shotgun.name: Shotgun
Shotgun.shortDesc: Short-ranged semi-automatic shotgun. Get up-close and personal to maximize damage.

Saw.name: SAW
Saw.shortDesc: Rapid-fire light machine gun with a large ammo capacity.

Fuel Rod Cannon.name: Fuel Rod Cannon
Fuel Rod Cannon.shortDesc: Magazine-fed, shoulder-fired heavy weapon that fires explosive fuel rods. Modern fuel rod cannons are significantly more accurate than those used by the old Covenant; a refinement sourced from the multi-species workshops on Venezia.

Energy Sword.name: Energy Sword
Energy Sword.shortDesc: Deadly plasma-based melee weapon. Successful strikes deplete the sword's limited energy charge.

Beam Rifle.name: Beam Rifle
Beam Rifle.shortDesc: Long-range semi-automatic energy rifle with variable-zoom 4x/10x optics. Use Smart-Link to line up headshots for one-shot kills.

Dmr.name: DMR
Dmr.shortDesc: DMR with Longshot Sight. Powerful and accurate semi-automatic rifle best used at mid to long-range.

Sniper Rifle.name: Sniper Rifle
Sniper Rifle.shortDesc: Semi-automatic multi-role heavy rifle with variable-zoom 4x/9x optics. Best used at long range in conjunction with Smart-Link.

Rocket Launcher.name: Rocket Launcher
Rocket Launcher.shortDesc: Shoulder-fired heavy weapon widely issued to UNSC Army, Marine Corps, and Spartan infantry to counter enemy vehicles and Promethean Knights. Can fire two missiles per magazine. Lock-on to air targets using Smart-Link before firing.

Magnum.name: Magnum
Magnum.shortDesc: Magnum with Projection Sight. Standard-issue semi-automatic heavy pistol. Use Smart-Link and call your shots.

Battle Rifle.name: Battle Rifle
Battle Rifle.shortDesc: Battle Rifle with Recon Sight. Standard-issue burst-fire rifle that can excel at any engagement range.

Spnkr Rocket Launcher.name: SPNKr Rocket Launcher
Spnkr Rocket Launcher.shortDesc: Make some noise! Twin-tube shoulder-fired rocket launcher with Smart-Link sights. Rockets can lock-on to air targets.

Halo 2 Battle Rifle.name: Halo 2 Battle Rifle
Halo 2 Battle Rifle.shortDesc: BR with Classic Sight. Reliable firepower never goes out of style. Battle Rifle with full-screen zoom.

Gravity Hammer.name: Gravity Hammer
Gravity Hammer.shortDesc: Brutally effective melee weapon that combines a hammer with repurposed gravitic impellers on the striking face. Each smash unleashes a damaging area-of-effect pulse with knockback. Regular melee attacks are weaker, but do not consume energy.

Brute Plasma Rifle.name: Brute Plasma Rifle
Brute Plasma Rifle.shortDesc: Newly manufactured Brute Plasma Rifles continue to appear in the hands of mercenaries and raiders, though their source is unknown.  All Brute Plasma Rifles are capable of unleashing a devastating fusillade of plasma bolts between emergency cooling breaks.

Retro Beam Rifle.name: Retro Beam Rifle
Retro Beam Rifle.shortDesc: The T-50 Beam Rifle is a Covenant long-range directed-energy weapon used by raiders, snipers, and scout-executors. Long-range semi-automatic energy rifle with variable-zoom optics. Use Smart-Link to line up headshots for one-shot kills.

Wasp.name: Wasp
Wasp.shortDesc: The AV-49 Wasp supplements existing stocks of AV-14 and AV-22 aircraft in Marine service. Close air support VTOL armed with heavy machine guns and twin rocket launchers.

Hunter Arm Turret.name: Hunter Arm Turret
Hunter Arm Turret.shortDesc: The Lekgolo that remain in this stolen limb retain a feral vestige of their once-expansive composite mind. The Wicked Grasp fires bursts of tracking plasma shots.

Reach Grenade Launcher.name: Reach Grenade Launcher
Reach Grenade Launcher.shortDesc: M319's are single shot, break-action grenade launchers that can fire a variety of 40mm rounds. Hold trigger for alternate fuse: release trigger to manually detonate with EMP effect. The grenade can be bounced to reach around cover.

Sentinel Beam.name: Sentinel Beam
Sentinel Beam.shortDesc: Fired in semi-automatic mode, or the trigger can be held down to charge and then release multiple plasma grenades in quick succession.

Phantom.name: PHANTOM
Phantom.shortDesc: Phantom deployable for campaign and warzone
